title: A packed colour
description:
Pack and unpack values with bit fields and masks, and check sizes with `_Static_assert`.

```
RGB565 of (255, 128, 64): 0xFC08
back to 8-bit: (255, 130, 66)
sizeof(Pixel) = 2
```
requirements: `typedef struct { unsigned b : 5; unsigned g : 6; unsigned r : 5; } Pixel;` and a mask-and-shift version in a `uint16_t`.
Convert 8-bit channels down (`>> 3`, `>> 2`) and back up (repeat the top bits into the bottom).
`_Static_assert(sizeof(uint16_t) == 2, "...")`; note that bit-field layout is up to the compiler, so files should use the masked version.
stretch: Convert a whole array of RGB pixels and compare the two versions' output.
